pretreatments.description: Heat pretreatment: The waste activated sludge was heated at 102 °C for 30 min to kill most methanogens.
Alkali pretreatment: 4 M NaOH was added to maintain the pH of all serum bottles at 10 during the digestion.

ZVI addition: 200 mL of the sludge was added into five 250 mL serum bottles, respectively. Five dosage levels of ZVI powder (0, 1, 2, 5 and 10 g/L) were added into the five serum bottles above, respectively.
